description: LIVE: a reduce-only stop that follows the price. side is the side that closes the position (sell closes a long, buy closes a short). Once it is trailing (immediately, or after activation_price is reached), Felix tracks the best price and sends a live reduce-only market close for size_usd if the price comes back by trail_percent from that level. It never opens or flips a position. The fill is bounded by slippage_bps from the quote at send time. Runs until it fires, expires (default 7 days) or you cancel_twap. idempotency_key is required; the same key always returns the same stop. Follow it with get_twap.

activation_price.description: Optional: start trailing only once the price reaches this level.

expires_minutes.description: Optional: cancel after this many minutes, 1 to 43200 (default 10080).

idempotency_key.description: Required retry-safety key (8-128 characters). The same key always means the same stop.

instrument.description: perp:SYM or lighter:SYM of the open position, for example perp:BTC.

side.description: The closing side: sell closes a long, buy closes a short.

size_usd.description: USD notional to close when it fires (at least 10).

slippage_bps.description: Optional worst fill vs the quote at send time, 1 to 10000 basis points.

trail_percent.description: How far, in percent, the price may come back from its best level before the stop closes (0.1 to 50).

name: start_trailing_stop
